result.summary: Transaction #84721 was observed as acct_A -> acct_B for ₦480,000 via MOBILE_APP at 2026-10-27T10:00:00Z. Rules R-001 through R-008 were recorded as TRIGGERED for this transaction, covering amount, velocity, device/phone/beneficiary/merchant sharing, and fan-in/fan-out counts. Graph evidence shows multiple SENT_TO links and shared devices, phones, beneficiaries and merchants involving accounts A-L, all from synthetic seeded records with the same observed timestamp.

key_findings.finding: Primary transfer acct_A SENT_TO acct_B observed as Transaction #84721 for ₦480,000 via MOBILE_APP.
key_findings.caveat: Fact directly stated in synthetic records; no independent corroboration and all records share the same observed_at.

key_findings.finding: Rule R-001 triggered for 48000000 kobo vs 40000000 kobo threshold, Rule R-002 triggered for sender acct_A issuing 2 transfers within 120 minutes, and Rule R-007 triggered for sender acct_A paying 2 distinct receivers, consistent with observed edges acct_A SENT_TO acct_B and acct_A SENT_TO acct_C.
key_findings.caveat: Trigger facts are observed; underlying transfer details beyond txn_84721 amounts and timing are not provided in evidence.

key_findings.finding: Device dev_04 is shared by acct_B, acct_C and acct_D, with Rule R-003 triggered for max device sharing of 3 accounts vs threshold 2.
key_findings.caveat: Sharing is observed as graph relationships only; no device ownership, login, or usage context provided.

key_findings.finding: Receiver acct_B has observed inbound SENT_TO from acct_A, acct_C and acct_D, with Rule R-006 triggered for 3 distinct senders vs threshold 3; additional links show acct_C SENT_TO acct_D, acct_D SENT_TO acct_E, acct_B SENT_TO acct_E, and acct_C SENT_TO acct_B, plus phone phn_03 shared by acct_B and acct_E with Rule R-004 triggered.
key_findings.caveat: Network pattern is observed but all edges share identical observed_at and lack amounts, sequence, or purpose; interpretation as coordinated activity is not established.

key_findings.finding: Wider graph shows additional shared identifiers: acct_F and acct_G share dev_02, acct_I and acct_J share phn_01, acct_F and acct_H share phn_02, acct_H and acct_I share beneficiary ben_01 with Rule R-005 triggered, acct_E and acct_F share merch_01 and acct_K and acct_L share merch_02 with Rule R-008 triggered, with other links including acct_G SENT_TO acct_H, acct_J SENT_TO acct_K, acct_L SENT_TO acct_K and acct_F SENT_TO acct_I.
key_findings.caveat: Observations are synthetic seeded relationships only; no evidence links these secondary clusters to txn_84721 purpose or timing beyond shared thresholds.

Multiple transfers and fan-in/fan-out may reflect legitimate peer payments, collections, or business activity.
Shared merchants and beneficiaries may reflect common popular merchants or family beneficiaries rather than coordination.
Identical observed timestamps and seeded synthetic patterns may reflect test data construction rather than real-world behavior.
